Captured bytes matched SHA-256 283fce6339ea5eb7cb2a972e5d381ae030271b6f6c536419e459dc605f8fd329 and the cited source witness. The matched section was Physical PDF pages 62–63, Chapter 2, BEGIN-PROGRAM, Syntax and Description. Oracle documents the PROGRAM section, delimited by BEGIN-PROGRAM and END-PROGRAM, as the required SQR section where execution starts after any SETUP commands are processed. This concerns the documented program entry sequence. DO is typical inside PROGRAM, and the manual permits other commands there. The title page scopes the rule to SQR for PeopleSoft in the October 2022 manual; optional SETUP and optional command choices remain distinct from the required section.
